name_zh: 卡德纳斯/墨西哥/石油/国有化/土地/革命/拉萨罗/PEMEX/埃希多
description_zh: 拉萨罗·卡德纳斯 (1895-1970) 墨西哥总统 (1934-1940) 土地改革者，通过石油国有化推动墨西哥现代化，建立PEMEX石油公司，推行土地改革和教育改革，被誉为 "改革者", 对拉美国家建设产生深远影响。
description_en: Lazaro Cardenas (1895-1970) Mexican President (1934-1940) land reformer, promoted oil nationalization to advance Mexican modernization, established PEMEX oil company, implemented land reform and education reform, known as "reformer", had profound impact on Latin American national construction.
reason_zh: 卡德纳斯代表拉美改革者如何通过土地改革和石油国有化实现国家现代化，如何建立国家石油公司推动经济建设，以及如何通过教育改革实现社会进步，体现了拉美改革精神。
reason_en: Cardenas represents how Latin American reformers achieve national modernization through land reform and oil nationalization, establish national oil company to promote economic construction, and achieve social progress through education reform, embodies Latin American reform spirit.
